title: aglaia kostermansii
intro: Aglaia kostermansii, commonly known as the Koster's Aglaia or Kostermans' Aglaia, is a species of plant in the family Meliaceae, native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. The plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Aglaia kostermansii include its potential to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Aglaia kostermansii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
